text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dober, I am sorry to impose, but could you 
perhaps take care of a favor for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure thing, if there's anything I can do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mm. A package addressed to Dober should 
arrive shortly, so I'd like you to accept 
it for her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
They are called German Irises; their 
ruffle-like petals are truly lovely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've heard you aren't particularly fond of 
overly cutesy things, but even so, I 
thought this would be perfect for you, 
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Its language of flowers is "burning 
passion"— and it's also the birth flower 
for May.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...! I'll cherish it 
and put it on display!
